rule.name: GrowingProcessArguments
rule.message: This joins a class path or path list into one argument of a process the method starts. The operating system limits a single argument (128 KiB on Linux) and the whole command line (32,767 characters on Windows), so the process does not start ("Argument list too long", "The command line is too long") once the project has enough modules or dependencies. Pass the list another way: an argument file (@args.txt for java, javac and many tools), the CLASSPATH environment variable or a manifest-only jar for a class path, or standard input.
